name: Aminorex
summary: Is an anorectic stimulant drug that was taken off the market after it was found to cause pulmonary hypertension. Potency wise it has been found to be roughly 2.5 times more potent than dextroamphetamine.

pharmacology.text: Aminorex is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA). Its EC50 values for induction of monoamine release are 26.4 nM for norepinephrine, 49.4 nM for dopamine, and 193 nM for serotonin. In addition to its monoamine-releasing activity, aminorex is a weak agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Stimulant; Appetite suppressant; Norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent

uses.text: Aminorex was formerly used as an appetite suppressant.
